name: Clean civil services answer: public service motivation, current affairs aware, service preference

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why do you want to join the civil services?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I want to serve the country at the grassroots level — public welfare and nation building are what motivate me. After working in the private sector for five years, I realized I want to be part of administrative responsibility that touches citizens directly. The constitution and civic duty matter to me; I want to be part of implementing public policy at scale.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Recent government schemes you find significant — what's your view on the latest policy developments?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The PM Gati Shakti initiative for infrastructure and the recent budget announcement on green hydrogen are two I follow closely. Niti Aayog's recent report on aspirational districts is also important context for any field posting.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My first preference is IAS, second IPS, third IRS. I'm willing to be transferable across all-India postings; I have no state preference and am open to any cadre allotment. Joining formalities and medical fitness are in order.
